title: Infinity yield updated by Rubo
script:
-- [[ RUBO ADMIN - ULTIMATE LOADER ]] --
-- This loads the full 400+ commands of IY but rebrands it for Rubo

-- Notification of Startup
game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
    Title = "Rubo Admin Loaded",
    Text = "Powered by Delta - All Commands Ready!",
    Duration = 5
})

-- Load the full command engine (Infinity Yield)
-- We use the official source so you get all 400+ commands (Fly, Fling, Kill, etc.)
loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EdgeIY/infiniteyield/master/source'))()

-- REBRANDING THE UI (Wait for IY to load then rename it)
task.wait(1)
if game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("EdgeIY") then
    local IY_UI = game:GetService("CoreGui").EdgeIY
    if IY_UI:FindFirstChild("Frame") and IY_UI.Frame:FindFirstChild("Title") then
        IY_UI.Frame.Title.Text = "Rubo Admin (Delta Edition)"
    end
end
